name: dbindex-simulator
description: DBIndex: User-Defined SQL Laboratory & Database Indexing Simulator

scripts.build:engine: sh -c 'if command -v g++ >/dev/null 2>&1; then mkdir -p engine/bin && g++ -O3 -std=c++17 engine/src/main.cpp -I engine/include -o engine/bin/indexer_engine; else echo "Skipping C++ engine compilation: g++ not present in environment"; fi'
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend

author: Bhalaksha Vairagkar
